spans.claim: Stella Nelson was seen at the post office with a ring on her engagement finger
spans.anchor: a ring on the engagement finger; a gold ring with little emeralds
spans.span: She raised her hand, and he saw a ring on the engagement finger; a gold ring with little emeralds, or they may have been sapphires-no, they were emeralds.

spans.claim: Darius Merrivan was found murdered with a gunshot wound and powder burns
spans.anchor: He had been shot at close quarters, for there was a blackening of powder upon his white waistcoat
spans.span: He had been shot at close quarters, for there was a blackening of powder upon his white waistcoat.

spans.claim: A letter threatening Merrivan was found on his desk
spans.anchor: I have given you a chance. You have failed me. You must bear the consequence
spans.span: I have given you a chance. You have failed me. You must bear the consequence.

spans.claim: A woman’s voice was heard by the butler in Merrivan’s house
spans.anchor: The butler had admitted nobody, and yet, coming downstairs half an hour after Mr. Merrivan had told him to go to bed, he heard the sound of voices, and one of those voices was a woman’s
spans.span: The butler had admitted nobody, and yet, coming downstairs half an hour after Mr. Merrivan had told him to go to bed, he heard the sound of voices, and one of those voices was a woman's.

spans.claim: The emerald ring found in the garden belonged to Stella Nelson
spans.anchor: It was Stella Nelson’s ring. He had seen it on her engagement finger in the post office
spans.span: It was Stella Nelson's ring. He had seen it on her engagement finger in the post office, and had felt a momentary pang of disappointment, the pang that all men feel when they see a pretty woman is not for them.

spans.claim: Arthur Wilmot possessed a stolen marriage certificate and forged bills
spans.anchor: He locked the door of his room when he got in, pulled down the blinds, and switched on the lights. Then he emptied the contents of his pocket

spans.claim: Abraham Selim and Darius Merrivan are the same person
spans.anchor: Abraham Selim and Merrivan were one and the same person
spans.span: Abraham Selim and Merrivan were one and the same person, and the threatening letter which he had thought had been received by Merrivan had really been written by him.

spans.claim: Mr. Boyd Salter was seen sleepwalking and reenacting the murder
spans.anchor: He was asleep. Andrew had known that when he heard the slurred, harsh voice
spans.span: He was asleep. Andrew had known that when he heard the slurred, harsh voice.

spans.claim: Salter died accidentally from a trap gun set in the park
spans.anchor: There was a crash. Mrs. Crafton-Bonsor had fallen to the floor in a dead faint
spans.span: There was a crash. Mrs. Crafton-Bonsor had fallen to the floor in a dead faint.

spans.claim: Scottie was injured by a gunshot wound during a burglary
spans.anchor: Scottie hurt himself. He didn’t want to go to a doctor, and, you see, I had a nursing course

spans.claim: Mrs. Crafton-Bonsor confessed her past and marriage to John Severn
spans.anchor: My name is Mirabel Hilda Crafton-Bonsor. I am not sure whether that was my late husband’s real name
spans.span: My name is Mirabel Hilda Crafton-Bonsor. I am not sure whether that was my late husband's real name.

spans.claim: The forged bills were signed by Kenneth Nelson and accepted by Merrivan
spans.anchor: Two forged bills drawn by Mr. Nelson in favour of Abraham Selim and accepted by my uncle
spans.span: Two forged bills drawn by Mr. Nelson in favour of Abraham Selim and accepted by my uncle.

spans.claim: The marriage certificate was stolen from Wilmot’s safe
spans.span: The marriage certificate is gone!" It happened that at that moment Andy turned his head toward the door.

spans.claim: The gamekeeper was the murderer disguised
spans.anchor: He was a gamekeeper. Which of the bunch I couldn’t swear to

spans.claim: The letter threatening Merrivan was written by Merrivan himself
spans.anchor: The threatening letter which he had thought had been received by Merrivan had really been written by him
spans.span: Abraham Selim and Merrivan were one and the same person, and the threatening letter which he had thought had been received by Merrivan had really been written by him.

spans.claim: Scottie was reformed and helped the investigation
spans.anchor: Scottie was a reformed character. I believe he is posing for Mr. Nelson

spans.claim: Arthur Wilmot’s secret profession was a milliner named Flora
spans.anchor: Arthur Wilmot; he is, in fact, Flora. He has three stores in town

spans.claim: The forged bills were destroyed in the fireplace
spans.anchor: There was in the fireplace when the police came upon the spot a heap of burnt paper
spans.span: There was in the fireplace when the police came upon the spot a heap of burnt paper, and it is clear that the murderer had ransacked the safe in search of these papers and had burnt them before he made his escape.

spans.claim: The final ghost is laid with Salter’s death
